name: Manjishtadi Thailam (Oil)

sections.introduction: Manjishtadi Thailam (Oil) is an ayurvedic formulation. This is formulated from the mixture of many herbs. This is known to treat problems related with eyes and head.
sections.ingredients:
Take the following herbs up to 96 grams together to prepare paste:- 

 Manjishta – Rubia cordifolia 
 Haritaki – Terminalia chebula 
 Vibhitaki – Terminalia bellirica 
 Amalaki – Emblica officinalis / Phyllanthus emblica 
 Jatiphala – Myristica fragrans 
 Anjana – Aqueous extract of Berberis aristata 
 Dalchini – Cinnamomum zeylanicum 
 Chanda – Cosstus speciosus 
 Mriganabhi – Musk 
 Ela – Elettaria cardamomum 
 Patra – Cinnamomum tamala 
 Sariva – Hemidesmus indicus 
 Musta – Cyperus rotundus 
 Katuka – Picrorhiza kurroa 
 Raktachandana – Pterocarpus santalinus 
 Jatamamsi – Nardostachys jatamansi 
 Tagara – Valeriana wallichi 
 Agaru – Aquilaria agallocha 
 Shati – Hedychium spicatum 
 Kushta – Saussurea lappa 
 Mulethi – Glycyrrhiza glabra 
 Nagakeshara – Mesua ferrea 
 Lotus – Nymphaea stellata 
 Hrivera – Pavonia odorata 
 Kamal – Nelumbium speciosum 
 Usheera – Vetiveria zizanioides 
 Karpoora – Cinnamomum camphora 
 Til oil – Oil of Sesamum indicum (768 ml) 
 Cow milk (768 ml) 
 Aloe vera juice extract (768 ml) 

 Method of Preparation 
 Take all the ingredients and add to Sesame oil and prepare the oil by oil paak method. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Manjishtadi Thailam is an Ayurvedic oil for external use. It balances the vata and pitta doshas. Herbs used in the formulation of this medicine are packed with the anti-inflammatory, anti-stress, soothing properties which are best indicated in almost all skin diseases. It helps to calm nervous system. Massage with this oil is very effective to alleviate the headache and mental stress even quite good in vertigo and dizziness. It can also take care of eyes problems.
sections.indications:
Vertigo 
 Dizziness 
 Headache 
 Eyes problems 
 Low vision 
 Eye pain 

 Usage 
 This is for external use.
sections.contraindications:
No contraindications 

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
